data.gender_notes: Nuzairah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'nuzara', meaning 'to illuminate'. In Islamic tradition, Nuzairah represents the radiance of faith and the light of wisdom. The name Nuzairah carries the meaning “Light, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nuzairah usually hope their child will grow to embody light, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nuzairah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
